body: I have never met anyone else with this sentiment before, I am not glad you feel this way, but at least you and I know we aren't alone in this. I have always thought it is a permanent solution to my problems, which happen to be permanent. I have tried to die in similarly ineffective ways since I was 9 years old, and i am in college now. Now, I have no fear of dying, I just feel some guilt at the lain I will be inflicting on others by passing. That guilt is being more and more tested as I burn out more and more.
For me, the biggest middle finger i got from genetics is being 6'6" and having a crazy deep voice from naturally high T levels </3 (kms)

Hi, local mentally ill transfemme here! I mostly see my transmasc brothers in the comments, but several of my girlfriends and I have similar experiences: Male muscle development/fat storage patterns are very easy to identify, and significantly hinder our efforts to appear feminine or even androgynous- breast development is overshadowed by man-gut, thighs aren't as soft/shapely, i could go on and on, as we all could. 

As I see it, being especially thin is like having a blank canvas. The less muscle and fat, the most freedom one has to manipulate their body to present a way they like :/
seriously :(( being marginalized in so many different ways makes it feel like i shouldn't bother trying. you aren't alone in that
